text:
I. WILL. NEVER. GO. TO. PO FOLKS. AGAIN. !!

BEWARE actual "Po Folks", you will pay OVER $3 just for your Iced Tea. Your child's drink which they will probably not finish will cost you MORE THAN $2 (even though the website clearly listed a child's 'bellywasher' is included)

They were a complete rip off for just plain OK food, go elsewhere. 

Also, when mentioned to the cashier about the discrepancy with website and actual menu, I was told I was not on their website but the company's site. I said I was on Po Folks website and was in Po Folks restaurant. They did not care, it did not matter to them...pay the bill I was told. I paid and left forever.

I will dissuade anyone who tells me they are going to this location.
Very mediocre bar fare. Couldn't seem to get our drink order correct and overcharged us. Won't be going back.

This place is HOT... and I don't just mean the sake and wasabi.  The vibe is hot.  The servers are hot.  The clientele is hot.  The hip hop is loud and pumping.  It's not for everyone, but they've clearly carved out a niche with the club crowd.  (Not my scene, so add a star to my review, if you're into clubbing.)

The service was solid, although I did feel like we were being pushed to the higher end items, and I get it, but if you don't receive the sashimi menu, with the more affordable rolls, ask for it.  Can't blame them for promoting the $20 rolls, but sometimes a $6.50 roll will do, and without the other menu you'd never know they had one.

We started with the hot sake, edamame and hamachi.  All very good.  For entrees, we went with the red dragon and upside down rolls along with an assortment of sashimi.  The best sushi/sashimi in town?  Not likely, but that's not what you're really here for, is it?

I did a lunch delivery today from Puccini's through Yelp and it was very convenient!  It did not take a long time and the Greek garden calzone was very good. I have had Puccini's before and their pizza is terrific!  I have not had a bad experience with Puccini's to date, so I'm grateful to be able to order lunch through them.  Puccini's has great quality food and the prices are reasonable,  so I would recommend this place to all of my friends.

The best rib eye me and the hubs have ever had. So delish. Pricey but worth it for a special night out.  I enjoyed the bourbon variety.  Bread pudding house made and delish as well. This is a sister restaurant to 1111 Mississippi which is another one of our favorites. Can't wait to come back. Very small dining area. Reservations recommended.

Visited here the other day. Everything was great, from the delicious food, to our server Zach. We started off with the crab claws and spinach dip. I had the Tchoupitoulas chicken and my boyfriend had cheeseburger. We split the crawfish macaroni together with our entrees. Everything was to our liking. Hot fresh food, tasty and a great atmosphere. Zach made the experience enjoyable as well.

Had the double Pork chops, Mac and Cheese and the Sweet Potato casserole was incredible. The food was great. The only negative was that it seemed that we were a little forgotten by waiter. Which with a group of 8 (you'd think that would be hard to do). Other than that, great food and awesome location.

The chicken wings are so good. Crunchy, crisp, fresh chicken without the antibiotics. I got the seasoned flavor which was a little spicy, however tasty. I want to try other flavors such as the sweet chili. It's a really cool spot to go to and enjoy. The servers were friendly and helpful.

Last weekend we were in the area and we have to stop by fire to-go order. We order through the phone and they have the curbside pick up. It was pretty to order on the phone I recommend giving your name and car model so there is no issue. My only complaint was then they gave us the bag of food it was not the correct order it was for the car beside us. We gave the bag right away but for health and safety reasons if I was the other car I would take the food out of its container and place it on a Tupperware and disinfect everything the bag touched. 

The food was flavorful. We ordered chicken tikka masala chicken was moist and tender. The vegetable pakora was full of spices and flavor I love fried veggies! I kinda missed the buffet and wonder if they'll ever have the buffet now that we are in a pandemic. The tea tasted off it seems like there was more cardamom than usual I didn't care for it much. They also add in gulab jamun as a free dessert! Please be patient as everybody works on upgrading their services during this time.
My favorite place in Tampa! Best greek salad, onion rings, and gyros around! The customer service is always outstanding! I always look forward to my Friday night Zeko's.

Great food.  Staff was friendly. 
Due to Covid: staff wore masks and gloves.  When I paid cash, I had to place it in a bin.  Staff took the money and placed it in a til and gave me change back in a bin again.  (Not sure the point of that when we are touching the same thing, but okay.)  Then the member turned and filled my drinks...all with the same gloves on.  The gloves are a false sense of security and cleanliness.

My heart belongs to this place. I've grown up eating Shapiros corned beef at everything from family gatherings to Colts watch parties. As far as delis in Indy go, this one can't be beat. They do everything right and make sure your money (slightly pricey) is well spent. The food is amazing as is the service. The place is always clean as well. If you are looking for the best chocolate cake in town, alas you've found it. Would recommend to anyone.

Been here for a few times and it never disappoints me! Tried the pork belly steamed bun, dan dan noodles, karaage rice bowl, and the crispy pata. Everything is so good! 
They change their menu often so you'll have new surprises every time you visit. 
The portion of the crispy pasta is huge, it can definitely feeds 3-4 people. And it's so delicious!
Another good thing is you can reserve the table on yelp which saves us for the line!

Had a very delicious meal and cocktails here with friends. Sunday dinner consisted of Fried okra, the dinner bowl, hamburgers, hot and crispy fries, and the halloumi. Service was fast. They were very accommodating. Can't wait to go back and try brunch

Can't believe it's been 6 years since I last reviewed! Always a favorite of mine when I'm looking for lunch - they've got an amazing selection of soup, salad, and sammies. The prom queen, tough love, and picnic basket are regulars in my rotation for salads - pretzel or whole grain still reign supreme for my bread choice. You can't pass up the treats! Cookies, brownies, and granola bites are all amazing ways to end your meal. A bit on the pricier side but portions are generous and ingredients are fresh and real!

I am updating my review to a full five stars. This place has, as I hoped, only gotten better with time. The staff and owner are amazing people who care about their community. The food continues to be DELICIOUS. You cannot go wrong, whether you eat in or get delivery. If you live in the area this is the #1 MUST TRY restaurant, hands down.

I had pizza from this place free at some event and it seemed great.  I needed to try it on my own dime to make sure.  I got two large double pepperoni pizzas (for only $19 thanks to their Facebook coupon).  I was in pizza heaven.  Good crust, good sauce and most importantly the pepperoni.  The pepperoni was the perfect level of crispiness without being burned and was even a touch spicy.  Thought I even ran into some fresh basil.  This is my new favorite Reno pizza!

Such a beautiful evening to sit out on the pier outside this restaurant. We had oysters on the half shell that were delicious and then each had a bowl of the clam chowder and shared a caesar salad. It was so good!! We had the perfect table right next to the railing overlooking the harbor and it was a gorgeous sunset!
Worst experience ever  food was terrible  not cooked  fully,,  dirty place. Old man wandering around the place with no idea what's going on, talking to himself. Just a weird place over all

A friend recommended coming here, but somehow I didn't realize it was a more formal place. Most of the people in the restaurant were more dressed up compared to at a nicer restaurant in California. 

Drinks: their cocktail portions are generous. The Lucky #7 was solid, well balanced. They also had a pretty good selection of wines by the glass - I would definitely recommend wine for the food. 

Menu: They have two tasting options, which are quite reasonably priced by California standards. There's also an a la carte menu, and you can order individual dishes off the tasting menu, which is nice. 

Food: 
1. Bread: they start you with a warm epi baguette with butter. 
2. Amuse: a garlic Parmesan custard with cauliflower hollandaise and cajun caviar
3. Crab beignet: 3 small beignets - mostly crab, not too much breading; frisée on the side 
4. Chopped salad: beets, dragon fruit, carrots, roasted turnips - refreshing and clean tasting, with beautiful colors 
5. Gnocchi: with blue crab, black truffle, parmesan - the gnocchi is the pillowy type. The flavor was good, but I could have used a bit more salt 
6. Flounder Pontchartrain: with a light thin crisped layer on top of the fish, great flavors, with shrimp, crawfish, and crab
7. Cornmeal chess pie: with popcorn ice cream, strawberries, popcorn. This was a good, lighter dessert. It had lots of textures and wasn't too sweet. 

For me, highlights were the flounder and the cornmeal chess pie. 

Definitely make a reservation for Friday or

If you love calamari and tacos, you MUST TRY the Kraken tacos. And get two orders (each order is two, I usually have a small stomach but for this I make room). It's literal crack. You must eat it immediately while the octopus is still hot and crispy. This will make your 2020.

This is our go to Indian restaurant. Always clean service is excellent. The food is delicious. More importantly it is constant. In the time of instant gratification it is good to slow down and really enjoy a good meal.

The Italian hoagie I thought had great quality, but the bread could have been softer and the sandwich could have had more meat. Overall one of the best delis in the area. 
The pork hoagie was one of the best hoagies I have ever had. Highly recommend.

Their cucumber salad were very very bland also potato salad was very grainy seems like it has not cooked all the way... when we order the fries with kimchi on the top, the food came out super fast too fast... I know for fact that fries need to be cooked about 3-4 mins... when I touch the fries it was warm like room temp warm disappointing... However the avocado fries was the bomb! When I order the combo meal I forgot what the name was but you pick two meat and two sides and waitress didn't tell us about up charges end up finding out about it on our receipt. We did give her nice tips due to COVID but not thinking about coming back.

We ended up arriving before our reservation because we were not sure where we were going. The staff was very accommodating and got us in as soon as they could. Food was great. Server seemed unable to handle the number of tables she had so we were unable to order cocktails. Overall great experience.

Wish I discovered them sooner! The best roast beef sandwich I have ever had! They do their own meats and it was so tender and perfectly seasoned. Came with au jus for dipping. I also ordered a brisket dinner for one of the first nights of Hanukkah and it, too, was delicious! The meat was tender and flavorful.  Great sides, too, including the yummy tomato bisque. Will be trying the corned beef next. 
I highly recommend Grumpy's!!!

Excellent service & food!

Guac is on point & very IG worthy of a picture. The place reminds me of the movie Coco, very cultural and full of color. Definitely a hidden gem in Philly that not many people know about, worth a try & definitely worth coming back to explore more of the menu. 

Only con: I wish this place had hard shell tacos ):

Very good! My first time at a Himalayan/Tibetan restaurant. Good flavor, not overpowering. I had the beef curry over rice which was good and we shared an order of dumplings which were also very good! The staff was friendly and dinner for two ended up below $50 with tip included. Would go back again.

Absolutely horrible place. Walk in 5 minutes before closing to have "manager" say sorry we are closed. Dining area full of families and 5 minutes left on the clock. Ya I call BS on the supposed Chick fil a service. I have ran fast food places before and fired a whole crew for doing just what happened to me. Can't tell you how the food is because I DIDN'T GET FED. Hay who ever runs this place. Fix it!!!!!!     #crapservice #craptud

Finally, The Love has reopened during this pandemic, and I was able to enjoy the dishes for which I have always returned.  The takeout was superb and I was able to have my order brought outside for me. When my husband and I opened our package we were so pleased for the packaging.  The sauces, sides, accompaniments were all packaged separately.  Since we knew each dish, we were able to plate and sauce each item as it would have been in the restaurant.  We thoroughly enjoyed the mushroom toasts.  Then we proceeded to devour the duck confit salad with ginger vinaigrette.  Our fried green tomatoes got a little recrisping in the oven and were great.  We ended with the fried chicken and a Panna Cotta for dessert.  Even that had the sauce and berries packed separately.  This was almost as good as being there - almost only.  We so missed the ambience of the restaurant, the quality staff, the focus on plating detail.  The food was great, but we so miss being there in person.  But we thank you, staff at The Love, for bringing back the tastes we so have come to love.
Amazing food and service with a smile thanks to Ray. The menu is incredibly customizable and I was able to taste all the various masala, daal, etc before ordering. Generous portion as well.
Really good but took way too long to make. Got the omu noodles w chicken...Delicious! Only giving 4 vs 5 stars bc it took 30 min to get my food.
My mom and I traveled to India, and we loved the food.  This place is as authentic as it gets.  Highly recommended.  Enjoy!

Good prices and my waitress was nice but the pizza was not that great. Also, I'm pretty sure my business wasn't wanted given the friendly way the other staff greeted all other customers but me and I sat there waiting for my order to be taken while they jumped to every one else. Kinda stinks to be treated this way when you're just in town for a conference. I was too dark to expect good service and it was evident. :/
We love Noble Hops!!! Leia is amazing! Great local spot and so happy to sit outside safely.

Food: Amazing
Staff: Amazing
Decor: Amazing

The portions are huge, the prep is excellent, and the selection is outstanding!

FYI - tip - do not use the online ordering system! It misled us to the pick time available by over 25 minutes and the service charge for using the online ordering (even though you still have to go in person to pick up the food) is $1.99.

In my opinion, the best Mexican restaurant in New Orleans. Not just Tex/Mex, but wonderful Mexican dishes with a New Orleans seafood slant. Ceviche is astounding. It is almost a Hall of Fame of quality tequila.It is very reasonably priced for the quality of food. Also, it is open on Sundays after Church. This is a stellar entry to the Harrison avenue culinary corridor.
The pizza is good but it's never ready on time anymore. Why even have ordering where you can specify a pickup time if you have to wait over 15 minutes when you get there?

Li's carry out has saved us from having to cook many a night over the past few years. Our family and guests always enjoy it. The food is fresh, quickly prepared, and consistently good. They have been accommodating of special requests like adding tofu or putting sauce on the side.

Wow, what happened here?    We used to live near here, so I went weekly, and the tacos were absolutely delicious and about 8 to 10 inches across.   We could barely eat two.  Absolutely delicious.  Since we moved I haven't had any so I told my husband how about I go get some today.  I ordered 10 Carna Sada, they came 4 inches big and I paid three dollars a taco and I paid $32 for 10 tacos are you kidding me?  I'm like OK OK their tacos are really good so it's worth it.   Until I went to warm one up in the microwave and I cannot believe how small they are now there's 4 inches are you kidding me?   They were not that good either, oh well guess I won't be going there ever again.    Geez. $3.00
A taco?   Rip-off.   Adios.

This place is inside a supermarket but dont judge on that !. Its the perfect to go place with a lot of vegetarian and healthy options with a smoothie bar and juice bar too !. I had the avocado toast and the power bowl which were the best I have ever had. The avocado toast was perfectly seasoned and the ezekiel bread was thin, wholesome and crunchy. The power bowl was really good with a powerful avocado cilantro and lime dressing with sweet potatoes, roasted cauliflower and quinoa. I still regret why I did not pick up a smoothie too !

Came here on New Year's Eve ready to spend generously on a nice meal to celebrate the end of a tough year. Little did I know, my food was the biggest joke of 2020!!! With the item called "1LB Colossal King Crab Legs" and a price greater than $50, I was expecting a normal serving of crab in its shell, where I crack it open like one would normally expect. This is how the food was presented to us. How can you describe this amount of crab as "colossal"? If it weren't for our kind waitress reimbursing us with a complimentary side, I would have given this restaurant 1 star. Save your money and go to literally any other steakhouse.

Great beer and the staff is wonderful. They made great recommendations and let us sample before we chose. They gave true hospitality. Can't remember their names but we went on 12/30/20 and I know the guy and by husband had the same birth year 89. He was an awesome server/bartender!

If I could give a no star rating I would due to their awful customer service. I have been going to this deli for 20+ years. Food is good but I can't look past the ignorant older women and owner. I either witness them being ignorant to another customer or I'm the brunt of their rudeness. In the last couple years customer service has taken a bad turn. They treat their patrons as if we are privileged to purchase their food. Foods good but it's not that good!! Good food plus ignorant people, not worthy of one of my hard earned pennies. We have many options in the area so we will be taking our business elsewhere. Good luck keeping a mom and pop shop afloat with those crappy attitudes!! If the old bags don't want to work anymore wish they would just hang it up and retire.

Been coming here for a few years and finally got around to writing a review for it lol. The sushi here never disappoints me! This is my go to place for sushi in Tampa. Wish they had more happy hour deals but you get what you pay for. The sushi quality here is great compared to some other places in town, and I hope that never changes. They do get busy on weekend nights so I suggest coming when it's not busy if you don't wanna wait 40+ min for your food

I agree with other reviews that the frosting melts when we get them out of the store. Staff should wait until the donuts are less hot so the topping sticks. The taste is great and fresh. Just wish the frosting stay on better.
Magnificent!!. Beautifully decorated. Food and customer service was great!!. I recommend!!. My new spot.
Miranda "like your rights " was amazing great waitress very funny and attentive the beer on tap at the table was pretty cool and the brownie was amazing highly recommend this place!

I ordered Panera to be delivered to my house yesterday since I was working from my home office. When I received it, I opened it up and thought I had the wrong soup. I usually order cream of chicken and you can tell right away that it's creamy from the clear top. When I opened it, the soup was not creamy at all and was just water and broth type consistency. The chicken looked very old and brown and the soup in general just looked very old. This is unfortunately not the first time this has happened. I have been to other Panera's in the area and we also came from Arizona where we never had this happen from the Panera. When it happened last time at this location we contacted the manager who was not helpful at all and suggested we come in to get a different one. Hard to do when you are working scheduled hours from a home office and you have one 1/2 hour break. To top it off, I realize Panera uses delivery drivers from another service, however, the instructions clearly said not to knock or ring the doorbell since I would be in meetings and I have 3 dogs that go insane. Sure enough, the delivery person rang the doorbell:  I had to put my video meeting on hold and on mute, answer the door and calm down my dogs. It was just a complete mess. I wouldn't suggest this location if you are going there for soup.

The food here AMAZING but the service here is subpar. We came for a weekend lunch and the service was not great - the waiter took a long time before he came over to get our order, when handing over the food he stuck his fingers in it, and didn't give us a pen when he returned the check. Its extremely unsanitary to put your fingers in other people's food and because of that (and the lack of social distancing), I would say that there it is extremely UNSAFE to come to here during COVID-19.

Now for the actual food itself:
- Daily Chicken Curry - The flavor was amazing (the pictures don't do it justice). The chicken was very tender but there wasn't enough rice for the dish and unfortunately this was also the dish the server put his finger in.
- "Turmeric" Special Chicken Biryani - Definitely must get here. I think this is the best biryani I've had which is saying a lot. The flavors are explosive. Oh and the presentation is beautiful too.

Overall, fantastic food but NOT COVID SAFE. Do not come right now, your food will have someone's finger germs in it.

We have been getting take out from GMG for the past few months. The dishes are always delicious with generous portions. The estimated time for pick up is always spot-on. They are going out of their way to take the best health precautions.

Wonderful food. I ordered the cream cheese rangoons as an appetizer, which were wonderful. I also highly recommend the Hanoi roll for an appetizer as well. For lunch I ordered the general chicken. Generous portion size, and great taste. Service is, as always, fast and efficient. Great local joint.

Pretty impressive! I must say I been on a pizza kick finding the best pizza in the city and my take aways from Kosmo's is as follows.

The toppings OMG! There meat lovers pizza which comes with every meat under the sun, also I added broccoli and mushrooms to make pretend I was being more healthy on this terrific pizza.

People have preferences whether it be the greasly typical old style pizza or this new Soho craze. I personally believe it is harder to find a good old school pizza as it is very hard to make a bad thin crust Soho pizza IMO.

This pizza is more on the Soho thin crust pizza state yet a little more doughly but it works perfectly. 

I highly recommend trying this pizza to scratch your itch but for me the perfect pizza is more of an old style pizza with thicker slices and more pronouced cheese and sauce. Either way this is definite way better then your run of the mill pizza.

Pro-tip : I have been hearing there personal pizza's are the way to go. I would order from here again to try it but have many more pizza spots on my list to try before I circle back.

Very nice bar on the inside. They also added a rooftop area that will begin serving food in February. I really like this place, every time I've gone the food was awesome and the drinks were good. The music here definitely caters to an older audience but isn't unenjoyable. The roof deck is beautiful and brand new. The bartenders have always been awesome, I've only had one bad experience with an employee here, a bouncer who was very rude to the man in front of me, but that happens, it's still a great place.

I've been wanting to go here for a long time. And finally after seeing Mean Girls with some friends we had an early dinner here. It's got a funky vibe with cool seating. There were 5 of and we sat in a semi-circular booth, which was perfect for us all being able to talk to one another. Also, our server was outstanding, even if we kept getting her name wrong. She was a good sport. 

To be honest I don't remember everything we ate, but I know it was delicious. I tried the tortilla soup, the muchos nachos, guac, and for dessert we had the El Vez. Now that I remember. It was amazing. You can't go wrong with peanut butter, salted carmel, and camelized bananas. 

Can't wait to go back!

If the quickest service you're giving your patrons is how fast your wait staff is picking up the payment from the table, expect zero tip. We sat waiting for over twenty minutes for half our order that never came. Two hand rolls and quite a bit of nigiri. No coordination of who was our actual server either. This is the third time we've experienced service like this from Ohana, definitely not making us feel anything relative to family. We're not going to be back.
Amazing food. Authentic, fresh Italian food. Very kind owner and employees, very nicely decorated and extremely clean. Have been there 3 times and haven't had a bad meal! It's all awesome so far.

I haven't actually explored much of the Hill. Charlie Gitto's was my first St. Louis Italian restaurant experience and it did not disappoint. The decor inside just felt so old-school and classic, I loved it. Soup and salad are not included with the entree, which I wasn't aware of when I ordered the lobster bisque. But the presentation of the bisque and the flavor made up for it. I wouldn't have thought lobster bisque in Missouri could be so tasty! Even the most basic dish, like spaghetti and meatballs, is so delicious and well-made here!

Fried goodness! We had oysters, clam strips, halibut and haddock! It was all fried to perfection. Golden and crispy. The fish (both halibut and haddock) was on the dry side, but the size and batter definitely more than made up for it. We ordered it for pickup and it was ready when they said it would be. Definitely a place that will fill your cravings and a must try!

Great steak but The wait was ridiculous! They need to make real reservations by phone or on open table. They have a stupid call in service that no one understands. Called in, still had to wait 40 mins when I got there which made us eat later than expected. Steak is great if you wanna wait about and hour and 20 minutes from walk in to when you get your steak. And yes! I timed it! Terrible experience that day.

This is a cozy little downtown spot with a rustic vibe.  We like sitting in the front by the windows to people watch.  Anything I've eaten there has been good, but don't expect TexMex, this is authentic.  My son loves the fried pork rinds.  The mescal drinks have a smokey flavor that combines with other indgredients for a refreshing cocktail.  You can't expect to get in and out of there quickly on a weekend night, so prepare to relax and enjoy yourself.

Literally sitting here since 9:10 pm and have yet to receive entrees, food is taking forever and server is avoiding us . There is a party of 5 of us and the amount of time we have waited for food was ridiculous. 1+hrs in counting .

I ordered from Biryani Hut for the first time and it was absolutely delicious! 

From their rice, which was seasoned and light, to the palak paneer... it was one of the best I've had! I also ordered the paneer tikka masala and it was very savoury. 

The naan was a little thinner than I expected but a must-order. 

I would definitely recommend this place, but know that when ordering the dishes are not described to come with rice or how many pieces of naan are included in one order.

I love to see small businesses still surviving through this mess. Function has a special place in my heart from my high school days back when I first discovered a world outside of Starbucks. Things look a little different and sitting indoors is something I'll have to wait a little longer for, but the Vanilla Latte still slaps, the baked goods still taste yummy and fresh, and the bottom line is that if any place is surviving the apocalypse, it's definitely this place. Stand outside in the cold watching people nearly get into car accidents and play the "how do I stay 6 ft away from the family coming towards me" hokey pokey, but when you get your cuppa, it's all worth it. Give love to the small biz as a solid to the ones we've lost this year.

Have eaten here twice.  Dinner and lunch.   Same menu but we had sandwiches and burgers for lunch.   The deviled eggs were amazing.  Would have never thought to put an avocado in it.  The burger was cooked perfectly.  My husband  had a salad which was fresh and more than enough to eat.  The veggie burger is good but kind of fell apart.  Maybe add something to it to make it stick together.   My filet at dinner again was cooked perfectly and very tender.    The salmon was also very good.   Great service.   Staff works together to make sure everyone is happy.

I've been here before and loved it. On Thanksgiving eve, after seeing a movie at Zeitgeist next door, stopped by about 11:15pm. I've had the double BBQ burger before which was yummy (if messy) and enough for two people. This time, knowing I'd be eating a LOT the next day, I got just the single. While the double is probably better value ($9.95 for the single vs. $11.95 for the double), the single was huge and stayed on the bun so was more manageable...and delicious (even tho I got it plain, i.e., not dressed). Plus it came with fries and a soda so was still quite good value.

Topped it off with a chocolate bacon donut with white chocolate drizzled on top--sublime!

The staff here are always friendly as can be. This is a place worth going out of your way for...and a MUST if you're in the neighborhood!

Our party of 5 visited Geraldines for a birthday dinner on a Saturday evening. We were seated upstairs, which was great because for most of the evening we were the only party up there and we basically had the floor to ourselves. We could still hear the live music from downstairs, so we didn't feel like we were missing out.

I really enjoyed the atmosphere. If I were going to a steakhouse, I'd much prefer to hit up Geraldine's again than any other option in town. You still get the great steakhouse food, but without the stuffy, pretentious atmosphere. It was casual, but still felt special. And it's a local place! 

We loved the Old Fashioneds - they come with a rock candy swizzle stick. All the apps we ordered for the table were great - crab cakes, calamari, and gorgonzola chips. My wedge salad was good. All of our steaks were big and cooked to order. Service was fast and attentive as well.

Only been here once but it was a great experience. Got the smoked salmon dip and the baller tots. Both were very good. Actually, the smoked salmon was wonderful. Atmosphere was just as delightful as the food. "Pandemic" rules are still in force so we will revisit when things lighten up a bit.

Fabulous restaurant. Better than Maryland, better than Joes in Miami! Truly the best crab I ever had.  KAT was an amazing server.  Highly recommend. Had an amazing time with my loved ones.  Truly a wonderful experience.  Amazing food geQmud-hiqfum-9xuvsa

Great find via yelp. Great beer selection with great unique food. We had the he dirty fries and they were great. My wife had the mother clucker and my daughter had the home wrecker. They looked and tasted awesome. I had the animal burger and it was awesome. The service was awesome. I suggest this place to any Gastropub enthusiast.

This location just opened up last Friday. 
First time trying this chain. 

The onion rings are a solid choice. They were fresh and crispy, and without that greasy over-soaked feeing you sometimes get from subpar onion rings. They also came with a sriracha aioli which I liked. My husband didn't care for it too much, but he loved the onions rings plain. 

The burger portion is decent for the price. In my case, I ordered a lettuce wrapped burger and like the fact that it came with two whole leafs of lettuce, but it was a little strange that the patty was ripped in half. If you are going to get a lettuce wrapped burger, you will definitely want to get two patties instead of one. 
My husband got a normal sriracha burger in a bun with one patty, and it was enough to satisfy him but he also wasn't super hungry. He liked the sriracha burger; it had good flavor but he did add a little bit of salt and a little ketchup on top. 

The service was good. After placing the order, we took our seat and our food was brought to us rather than us having to go up to the counter to collect it. Not sure if that's normal or if it was because it wasn't busy and so they were able to do that for us but it was definitely nice to have that level of service!

Will come back again to try their other burgers and shakes!

This restaurant is a perfect example of you get what you pay for...the prices are a little higher, but oh my goodness it's the best breakfast North of downtown. Coffee is amazing as well as everything we have tried on the menu. Also the ambiance is incredible! We go almost every week now and are never disappointed!

Los Gallos is my go-to Mexican in South Philly (and there's no shortage of great Mexican places in the neighborhood, so it's a high bar!) Their enchiladas are so good but every time I try something new it becomes my new favorite.

We dined at this location for dinner and tasted their new menu items. They now have red and white sangria and Bloody Mary's for dinner options. A lot of their dinner items have been updated or new modified recipes. I love Metro Diner because they have a very clear gluten free menu. The staff is knowledgable and trained well on food allergies and cross contamination. I have never had any issues with my food and this is my second location to visit. I had the grilled salmon, the choice steak, the seaside salad (without the quinoa), and the pot roast. Everything I had was great, the grilled salmon and steak were my favorites. They all are gluten free. My husband loved everything, but the meatloaf really stood out to him. He said it was well seasoned and savory. The mashed potatoes are very very creamy and they tasted great with every dish we had. I am glad they switched to the fresh veggies; they were nice and crisp and obviously tasted fresh. I can't wait to return for brunch and breakfast and try more food. As always the staff was so friendly and attentive. the white sangria was my favorite. The location also has a cute outdoor seating area. this location is newly renovated (the plaza) its very very nice. Parking is right in front and you can also access the building from North A street if you want to avoid traffic!! This place is great for cheap eats.

Definitely a fun hole in the wall to go drink at and hang out. The food and drinks are cheap, they do open mic nights, trivia nights, kereoke too. The staff are great and treat everyone like family. If you're looking for a new local bar in your area to frequent, Keiths Oaks Bar & Grill might just be what you are looking for. If you haven't been its definitely worth a trip out if you live in the area
The most delightful crab salad with arugula, grapefruit, fried shallots and a perfect vinegarette dressing. Love the ambience. Felt very safe with the COVID precautions.

Joseph's USED to be wonderful. I remember when they make the best Bloody Mary in the city. I think they actually had a patent pending on the recipe. They were wonderful but the thing that made them stand out was the long piece of provolone coated in course black pepper on a stick. Amazing. Also the best pizza and cheese steaks anywhere.

That was then and this is now. I couldn't wait to get there when we moved back to Philly after many years away. The pizza was bland and soggy and worse, the Bloody Mary's with that awesome sharp provolone had gone the way of the dodo.

What a disappointment!

Terrible service. No sense of urgency. I placed a "rapid pickup order" three days in advance and when I showed up 7 minutes passed the pickup time my to go coffees weren't ready. After I told them I was in a huge hurry (hence placing the order ahead of time) I proceeded to wait 10 more minutes. Won't be back.

So glad they survived the pandemic & are open serving diners better than ever. This is the second time for us dining here & they exceeded our expectations. This is what the good & reputable restaurant should be, we murmured, as compared with the 3x$$$ restaurant in Boulder, Utah where we had the worst dining experience ever. How efficient, effective, polite, & professional the wait staff were & how delicious the meals were! I wish their continuous success for years to come. Highly recommend!

Drove by this place dozens of times over the last several years, but never gave it a try until tonight.

Upon entering, the restaurant reeked badly of fish. I understand that it is a seafood restaurant, but it just smelled cheap. We opted to sit on the patio. We sat at a metal patio table, with white tablecloth, and plastic chairs. The cheapness factor again. At least there were cloth napkins.

I ordered a quesadilla for an appetizer and a salad to follow. The quesadilla came out in decent time. It looked like something I would have made in my own kitchen, minus the excessive cheese that was inside it. Seriously, there was nothing appealing or appetizing about this appetizer, in fact, I only ate two pieces as there was just way too much cheese. Maybe a garnish would be nice?

My Caesar salad came out shortly after. It was a wedge of Romain lettuce with a drizzle of Caesar dressing on top, and some parmesan cheese. I am not a fan of wedge salads, because I would prefer to eat my food prepared, not prepare it myself. The anchovy paste was overpowering in the dressing. I couldn't escape the fish smell in this place.

Part way through dinner, an elderly woman broke out in song, singing Memory, from the Cats musical. Perhaps if she had a better voice, I wouldn't have minded so much. I believe she was the "icing on the cake" for my experience here.

Judging by the customers, this is a nice hang out for the over 65 crowd. it really is just not my idea of a place I want to eat at. Ho

Once again the manager is a complete unkind, nasty, person.  She has no patience, is no help, very, very poor customer service.  Maybe if you explained something about the sushi we might have ordered more but no she is A CAPITAL "B".  If is wasn't for the only person I saw actually work, a very nice man, we would have left no tip at all.  Great way to ruin a perfectly good birthday you "B" manager. What goes around comes around....
My rating is "0"
This place was very good! The atmosphere was amazing and the staff was both helpful and friendly. It's a bit on the more expensive side but definitely worth it!

Food is good and and the place has a unique menu with a great location and atmosphere.  Our last experience was a bit disappointing with the bus-boys practically taking your food away while eating.  I'm not sure why they didn't understand it was rude. I let the manager know of the situation but she didn't really care and said they were in training.  Maybe it was bad timing or they are just hustling the customers through the order-eat-out cycle to get more people through.  Given the prices, I would expect better service.

SO stinkin' good! I am obsessed with their Akamaru Modem dish. It is honestly the best ramen I have ever had. Even my husband who doesn't normally like ramen likes this dish. All of the ingredients are perfect and the noodles are the right texture. 

I have probably had these at least 10 times now and crazy enough have never dined in, only done take out. 

Highly recommend all around!

I saw some info on it on social media and gave it 2 weeks to get some kinks out. They are doing a great job with social media marketing.

Atmosphere = very relaxed and inviting. They did a good job of making a small space seem large. Love the little game area with retro game consoles.

Service=friendly and attentive. Whom I asume is the owner/manager was intrested in feedback to improve. It took a min to make our sandwiches but I belive they will work out all the kinks on that.

Food and Drink= Coffee items were all good I was in a group of 4 and tasted all of them. Paninis were all amazing. They did a good job of creating them. I love that they have weekly specials like empanadas. Will be back just to hang out

Unfortunately I cannot leave a good review. Service was great but the food was a c- 
We ordered the Georgia peach pancakes and the peach topping was cold and the peaches hard 
There was no flavor in the peach topping either. The bacon was average.

Definitely coming back to this Gem of a place! This restaurant offers traditional Korean dishes at its best! First time coming here, I immediately noticed the cleanliness. It didn't take long to see that every employee was engaged, gracious and genuinely pleased to serve their patrons. During these COVID times, it was comforting to see all employees wearing face masks. Thank you to the owners of Hana Garden for providing great service and such tasty food!

We had dinner last night at Harry and Izzy's downtown. We definitely had our share of appetizers to start...they were all fabulous! You can't go wrong with the shrimp cocktail, but a surprise hit recommended by our server, Stephanie was the Spicy Asian Shrimp. It's similar to a bang bang shrimp with so much flavor and crunch, the best we've ever had!
Our entrees were hot and cooked perfectly...we ordered the sliders and Tuscan pizza. And do I even need to confess we had dessert? Everything was so good! 
I feel I need to mention Harry and Izzy's is doing a GREAT job with social distancing and extra cleanliness. We ate inside due to the weather, but they do have outdoor seating. We had plenty of space out from the other customers and even the pens are cleaned after every use. 
I would highly recommend this restaurant!

I ordered a small Chai Latte and a large Iced Cafe Latte. 

Chai: it's just milk, barely sweetened, no chai. 
Cafe Latte: I asked for it to be sweetened, it's not sweetened at all and it's the same size as my small chai when I ordered large. 

They get 2 stars because the workers are nice and polite. I would just double check your order before leaving, I went through the drive-thru and was too far to return back to correct the order.

Update: We ordered take out online from the Horseshoe Grill with a designated pick up time. The order was handed to me ONE minute after the time slot, and the food was excellent as usual! 
Enjoy excellent food and support your local restaurants during this crazy time!
We stopped by the Horseshoe Grill for lunch last week and were extremely happy with everything we tried! I had the filet mignon which was cooked PERFECTLY, with thick cut fries and a side salad. The steak was thick and butter tender and the flavored pad of butter on top was the perfect compliment to the flavor of the steak.
The hubby ordered the rack of ribs and was quite pleasantly surprised over how meaty, tender and flavorful they were (he cooks some of the best ribs I've ever had so it is very rare for him to compliment others). He also loved the onion rings, which he said were nice and crispy. The salad bar carried the usual toppings but the yummy blue cheese dressing was so thick and chunky that it earned this little side note, lol
We will most certainly return awould definitely recommend this restaurant!

Walked by this charming diner many times. After reading some reviews, we decided to stop in for breakfast. OMG! How did I not know about this place sooner? We both had the CBB. Trust me, this is awesome!  Just the right amount of biscuit, cheese, jalapeños and eggs.  Not too hot. Just the proper amount of everything. 

Service was great. Fast and attentive and extremely friendly. I'll be back.

This restaurant was so good! Authentic Vietnamese food. They have 3 different pho broths (chicken, beef, pork).  You can customize your pho to your liking. The service was stellar! I'll definitely be going back to this place.

I adore Miel Patisserie! The wide range of pastries taste as though they came straight from Paris. The teas and coffees are refreshing and delicate in flavor. The sandwiches are wonderful.

Whenever I step into the cafe, I feel like I leave Philly for a quick moment. The atmosphere is clean and elegant, making it a lovely spot for a quick meet up with friends, a study spot or just a breath away from the city.

The hot pot and bbq are delicious and they do a great job at adhering to Covid safety protocols.  Dividers between tables, face masks and shields on employees, gloves at the sauce station and temperature checks upon entering.

Terrible management, poor service, mediocre food. It's all going back to the poor management. The owner, Jay is extremely ignorant. I would avoid this place like the plague. This guy made a huge scene because in our group of 8, one of us had a MAGA hat on. Never mind that all we did was walk in to grab dinner. That's it.... one persons hat was enough for him to cause a scene and refuse to serve all 8 of us. I would understand if someone was making a scene but nope, it was just this pompous jerk.... it's ok, we will surely share our experience everywhere!!!

This place never disappoints. This time we ordered take out from work. I was a little worried cuz  lots of times when you get takeout its not as good as dine in.  I was so wrong! Everyone was really happy with their food. The two pan sam blueberry lemon pancakes r the best. Everyone at work was dying over them. I go the carne asada tot Benedicts which i had never got before and i was not disappointed.  My coworker ordered the wolverine 2.0 Benedicts that looks amazing as well.  Thats the ones i usually order. I can't get enough of this place. Highly recommend it.

I went here with my friend and we ordered the chicken fried noodle and the orange chicken. Both were absolutely delicious. I liked that the orange chicken was spicier than most places and it was very flavorful! We also ordered the biscuits which are delicious and fluffy! I will definitely be getting food from here again!

I've been reading about Saint Germain and their tasting menu for quite some time.  Each month they do one weekend where they offer a vegetarian tasting menu (they are not able to do substitutions, so this was the only time that would work for us).  We finally decided to make a reservation and go.  Since they have a courtyard, I originally requested to sit outside.  When they called to confirm my reservation, they left the most detailed and thoughtful voicemail answering all of my questions!  They assured me that although the tasting menu wasn't available outside, we could move outside for our final course and up until that point, we were the only reservation.  I decided to do the wine pairings with the tasting menu and it was a great decision!  All of the wines were awesome and I had never had any of them before!  Our server was extremely attentive and very descriptive with each course!  The food is more on the experimental side of the spectrum, which I love!  Even my husband who typically does not go for that was blown away by the creativeness and flavors!  While it is a bit pricey, especially if you chose to add wine, I would highly recommend and plan to go back soon!

Spending a day in Tucson and decided to check this place out.. Glad we did.. So good.. staff was super friendly.. food was delicious.. stick to your bones, feel good BBQ.. Place was cute, nice covered patio to sit on.. Bathrooms were very clean.. I already have my next meal planned in my head for next time..

Being from New Jersey, I find it hard sometimes to discover small places with really good food here in Florida. I was greeted by some amazing people who made me laugh and helped me decide what to get. Definitely call ahead to find out where they are, but the people I spoke to were very kind to help me find their location. I got the mixed plate with kimchi fried rice to try a little bit of everything and I would say the short rib was my favorite, but they were all super tasty! For the price, taste, and the quality of service, I will definitely be back for more!

SO HAPPY the Brasserie is back open just in time for Chicken & Waffles on New Years Day. Definitely one of our favorite brunches in town.

The new management and staff is awesome. Super attentive and friendly, same great quality of food and drinks. Will be back soon! (After the January "diet"...)

Today I hit the jackpot!    I found Honey Bakery!
I have been told by many that I would NOT find
A good Dim Sum Restaurant in all of Reno  for the past 3 years.     Well that may be so BUT I have found a Bakery with Chinese baked goods AND
A GREAT VARIETY OF  Dim Sum.     First of all there's  plenty of parking.     The place doesn't 
open at the crack of dawn.   It opens at 9:30am.
They have a busy time usually lunch time.     The baked buns are fresh with a big variety.    Sweet and savory meats.     The Dim Sum can e fresh sealed OR you can take it home and steam it to your time of need.     Pretty traditional.     I was told you can also order some delicacy's .     I'm in such a happy place today that I'm still smiling!  I will be back!!!!!    BY THE WAY,  don't go in looking for doughnuts!

Monsoon? Good. 
Baked potato? Good.  
Burger? Blaaaaaaaaaaaand. 

I couldn't add enough salt to make the meat taste anything more than just OK. I just don't understand a deliberate lack of seasoning. They only have like 8 things on the menu. Those items should be impeccable. 

I would probably go next time just for the drinks.

Came here at 8 in the morning, hoping to grab a quick bite and some coffee for my morning commute. I looked at the menu beforehand and called ahead of time so I could pick it up and go. The owner was very happy to explain the different types of coffee for me, and answer any questions that I had. I decided in ordering a buffalo sandwich, some hash browns, and a white mocha. Let me just let you know that the coffee is where this place shines. The food is pretty mediocre, but I will definitely be back for the coffee. My buffalo sandwich was pretty dry, and the lettuce was already browning. The hash browns were more flavorful than most but incredibly oily to the point where you wouldn't even want to consume the second one. The real star of the show of this place was the coffee. The white mocha was a light drink but had an intense caramel flavor. I will definitely be coming back for the coffee next time.

Had to submit this review since I was lured in by the 4.5 stars and 600 reviews. I just don't understand.

The good: the service was fantastic - attentive, friendly. And the hostess estimated exactly how long the wait time would be. The setting inside is cute. 

The bad: The food. And we tried a lot of it. Duck confit waffle -- waffle tasted like it came from food service (just like what you'd get at a Hampton Inn breakfast), duck confit was fine but no sauce made it very plain, and a bone buried in the duck. Blueberry pancakes were a grease bomb -- thin and actually soaked through with butter. Breakfast sandwich with gruyere, avocado, arugula, and eggs -- had two chunks of avocado in there that still had the skin on, and the gruyere was just a thin slice of unmelted cheese at the bottom of the sandwich, you could hardly taste it. Hubby's breakfast sandwich was tasty but also a grease bomb. Mussels with chorizo was probably the best thing we had, but the sauce was very thick / tomato-saucey (not very nuanced, which was a surprise since it had saffron and chorizo in it). Two cocktails sounded fancy from the description but ended up tasting cheap and sweet. 

On top of this, every time the kitchen door opened, this horrible stench came through and made it over to our table. The kind of smell you get when you walk by the parking lot outside a restaurant at the end of the night and they are dumping out buckets of dirty gunky oily water (I know this smell because a restaurant is d

I have been coming to the pharmacy for many years now and I have been able to count on them for quality food. They have amazing burgers with vegan and vegetarian options as well as a wide variety of beers. They also have really good drink substitutes such as milkshakes and homemade sodas. This is a really good place to meet up with friends or even go on a date! They have an outdoor seating area as well as bar seating and tabletop seating. The only frustrating part is that you have to find street parking because the lot behind the restaurant only has six open spots. I usually order the farm burger with tots but I've also tried a few other things on the menu and have been pleased. I will continue to come back!!!
This is a tiny place with a long wait but definitely worth it! Hibiscus Mimosa is a must try! I think this was the friendliest place in New Orleans.

What an incredible night at Sonic in Sparks supporting Solace Tree, a nonprofit that helps grieving kids, teens and adults (for free!!) as well as celebrating the Cain family who were helped by Solace Tree when they lost their parents way too soon. Sonic staff were handing out all their go to foods, yummy corndogs, jalapeno poppers (finally know where I can get ones stuffed with cheddar cheese instead of cream cheese), mozzarella sticks, and drinks while local bartenders served up tasty cocktails that were their twist on a Sonic menu item! And all for the good of supporting Solace Tree and, of course, an awesome Sonic Shake fashioned trophy! Everyone put their heart into this fun night and made it a great experience. If you haven't visited Sonic yet, do it. The food is good and the staff really care about  serving the public. Plus, coming soon, Sonic in Reno across from Whole Foods!!
Main Street is a great place to eat a d has a great hometown bar atmosphere! Great food a d drink specials and the staff takes good care of you!
Food was great! Ordered zucchini fries, eggplant Napoleta, crab cake and Chilean sea bass. All very good. Outdoor ambiance is a vibe.

This was a take out order of pizza only. However, it was a pretty good pizza. Very helpful staff and expedient service. I would like to go back one day for a sit down dinner. It seems to have good potential.
So glad that I found this place.  Excellent food!  Enjoyed the lasagna and fettuccine Alfredo! Lunch was delicious--we will look forward to coming again for dinner.
The food and atmosphere was great as well as the service from our waitress. Very charming with many seating areas to seat two or twenty two. Looking forward to returning when we are back in town.

I really don't know what's so hard about cooking a dish well done. I ordered tangdi kabob and andhra fish fry well done. Chicken was pink, fish was not cooked all the way. When a customer asks for an item cooked WELL. Cook it well for Petes sake. Unless their is another term you guys use for well done , please let me know . Or maybe your cooks need to be hooked on phonics to understand English. I don't know what was so hard about well done. These items was for a pregnant girl and u cooked food that wasn't . SHAME ON YOU.
I love this food.... You can always get the best chicken wings in the city and the beef dumplings are the with the noodles and the rice.. Love this place !!!
Love this place! Line is usually pretty long (which proves just how good this place is) but the staff is super friendly and they do their best to get your food out asap.

This is a must have for barbeque! If visiting Nashville, put this on your list. I went in between lunch and dinner and split a meal with a friend which I highly recommend doing because even at that time it was busy. They also have a bar which was great! Food was quick and they had staff cleaning up after people which was great and our interaction with them was amazing. They were all so nice and helpful!

The food at Saffron is amazing! We order every week and the food is always fresh, delicious and plentiful. The staff are so nice and they are happy to accommodate your request to adjust the spice of the food.

I usually don't write any reviews, but I had to this time to make everyone aware. I ordered 3 burritos and chips, guac and salsa during the prime lunch time hour. Picked up my order and on my way back to the office & realize they didn't include the chips...so I went back again and got the chips but had to wait 10 mins because the guy was on the phone. This isn't even the highlight, I'm more than half way done eating the food and I find out what appears to be a mosquito in my food! Gross...I won't be going back again.
Beautiful! Absolutely love how beautiful this shop is and the cake was really good. I loved the gum ball on my cake as well!

We had a destination wedding in December and choose to have our dinner at Monty's. Most of our guests had never been to New Orleans so we wanted somewhere with great food, the culture and ambiance, and fantastic staff. Monty's always delivers in those areas and that is why we never visit without several stops. Dustin our regular waiter has become more of a friend that we have to say hello to everytime we're around and made sure that he was included in our special day there. The gumbo is my favorite, our Louisiana guests said the jambalaya was some of the best they have ever had,  and you cannot forget about the Louisiana Lemonade.  We cannot wait to return to support our favorite business again!

The staff was soooo rude and took for ever to get one thing out they where even making tik toks in the back of i could give this place negative stars i would and also, when ever i come up here there icee machine is always broke so burger king better get on this because you lost my business (also no apple pay)

Great restaurant,  very affordable and super friendly staff.   I have had several meals here after a round of golf with my Dad.  Tonight they had  karaoke and the place was packed and everyone was having fun.  Friday nights they have a live band.  The demographic of the clientele was the over 50 crowd so don't expect it to get to rowdy
This is a fun place to come with family and friends. The cioppino is awesome and full of delicious seafood. A large serving so come hungry! The servers are lovely as well. Great for lunch or dinner.

I was surprised. The inside of this place has a nice vibe. The line moves rather fast for the size! It's a popular place and it's because the food is great! The hot fries were light, crispy, and seasoned well. The gumbo felt like it was missing something maybe some heat they have sauces at the table but at most places those sauces just don't compliment the taste the dish goes for. I was afraid to try them. I do wonder if there is a way to ask for a spicy gumbo cause that wound be awesome. I guess I'll have to find out next time i visit. I will be back!

So far this is one of the best Thai restaurant that we've been to.  The food are awesome!  It's very tasty.  The only downside is they don't have enough space to accommodate a large group of people because of COVID they have limited seats. All we ordered are delicious.   My husband is a vegetarian & loves the tofu, spring roll & Kao Pad fried rice.  He is more of a fast food guy & doesn't eat  rice before but now he's addicted to Thai foods.

We had very high expectations about this place after reading all the reviews and hearing it from friends. The only good thing was our friendly waitress. Sushi took 50 minutes to serve on a sunday night for 2 people. Every single roll, we tasted (not finished) 4 rolls, was full of sauce and stuffed with a lot of rice that we couldn't even taste the fish. Will not return.

A good Thai place but is a little bit over priced for lunch.

Came with a few people for lunch on a Wednesday and it was not crowded.  Our meal was quick to arrive and tasted good.  I ordered from the dinner Menu and got the pad se ew since that was not available on the lunch menu.  Not sure why since its just noodles and protein not that dissimilar to other items on offer.  The regular lunch specials came with dumplings or spring rolls but the portion size seemed a little bit smaller and was about the same price the dinner portions without any sides.

My Pad se ew was a bit on the sweet side and I thought a little too much sauce.  It was good but it might just be a personal preference that I like stir fried noodles a little bit dryer.  I noticed that they have a $20/bottle wine special and that seems like a good deal.  So I think I'd rather come here for dinner and feel much more justified.  I'd recommend this place for dinner for sure.

My family and I will not be returning to this facility. During these times you would think people would be more sympathetic and considerate of certain things that are strongly offensive. This picture is hanging inside the mens bathroom. Of all places to have this photo and it is right in the privacy of the mens restroom. Why is this picture being displayed at all? Especially inside a public facility that is to accommodate all walks of life. If we had seen this photo before ordering our food we would have not eaten at this establishment to begin with. We are offended that even with everything going on within the black community specifically that this was acceptable by the owner to have publicized. Mockery of lynching and hangings of black men by using a white male is uncalled for. We have always been mocked by society and it is becoming tiring to see the ignorance and disrespect that people still have today. We are hurt that people still carry this ignorant mentality that is completely unnecessary.

Had a great time here for a first time date! The crew was really friendly and helpful, ready to answer any and all questions. They even gave us suggestions based on our likes. At first the the prices were a bit scary because it's only burgers and fries lol. Well worth the 12 bucks nonetheless. Yes, The Burger Bank only sells burgers, fries and beverages! The milkshakes are REALLY good too. Nice and thick as well. I totally recommend this spot for a good burger!! P.S. There's at least a 30 minute wait as the burgers are cooked fresh! #friendly #clean #halal

The service was wonderful! Delicious food and the variety was great. We definitely recommend the salmon dip! My family and I have been coming here atleast once a month whether to dine in or grab it to take home. We are always pleased with the fast and friendly service and having the employees suggesting options always pays off. We have never been disappointed by this place.

First timer. Must say it was run professional from the moment we walked into the restaurant. Had a reservation at 6:30 it was seated I 6:30. Our server was awesome the food was fantastic. I'm in the restaurant industry and I would recommend this place. And will be definitely returning.
The sushi was fresh and delicious. The service was great. They gave us free fried Oreos and soup. The gyoza were the best I've ever had.

This is me and hubby's very first time to a Longhorn Steakhouse. Neither of us were too much of a "steak person" in the past, so it never crossed our minds of dinning here. But ever since of our visits to Outback, we decided to give Longhorn a try. And it definitely didn't disappoint.
 
Even though Philly's indoor dinning maximum capacity is around 25%, we were seated immediately upon entry. Our waitress Diana came shortly after and took our drinks. She also informed us of some out-of-stock menu items, which is definitely a plus. We started with the Wild West Shrimps, which we didn't like too much. We also order a White Peach Sangria, it is ohhhh-so-fruity, we love it! 

As for entrees, hubby order the extra well done filet with lobster tail with grilled shrimps added. I order the well done ribeye with lobster tail and grilled shrimps added. Our side orders were asparagus, brussel sprouts, and fries. Our entrees were very delicious, especially the side orders. Hubby and I love their brussel sprouts and asparagus, they were seasoned very well.

Been here twice and both experiences have been exactly the same. Rude employees that make good burgers. Music is so loud it feels like I'm trying to order food in a live performance venue. Apparently the workers get annoyed when you can't hear them over the blasting music. I'd probably come back again in a few months but the experience kinda stops me from coming more frequently.

As a lover of KBBQ, I really do appreciate this spot as it is the only place within 40 minutes. So be prepared to wait especially on the weekends.

Though the inside is small and does not have too much seating, they can sit anywhere from 1-8 people at their tables. The All You Can Eat deal is good! $17.95 for the basic menu which has a lot to choose from! The service is excellent and the staff tries their best to serve you while handling the busy day.

I just wish they had more spots like this in SB! So if you are a fan of a different, unique and fun kind of dining experience, this is the place for you!

The service by our waitress was great. The things that were not great were due to the kitchen staff. The food took a long time to come out after being ordered. Also when the appetizer of Chips & Salso were recieved the chips were extremely greasy. I know times are different with COVID but with a reduced seating inside I would expect the precision or speed of the kitchen to be at least the same as before COVID.
Great casual place for breakfast and lunch. The bakery items and fresh Cuban bread are also fantastic. Indoor and outdoor seating and pet friendly.
An absolute amazing place to eat. I love me some mexican food. This place should get 10 stars. Seriously. Green ceviche and the moles were outstanding.

This is such a wonderful neighborhood Mexican restaurant. Unlike many of your typical Mexican spots where the food is heavy and greasy, everything at Garcia's is light, fresh, and so flavorful and delicious. Not to mention, the chips and salsa are the absolute best! My husband and I come here at least once a week, and have never had a bad meal. The service is always quick and friendly, Isai takes great care of us every time we come in!

We dined here during Mardi Gras weekend 2020. Due to Covid, I'm late on the review but it is as already written. I wanted to give the restaurant its review. There was a slight wait with no reservations but more than manageable. We had the pleasure of sitting at the oyster bar which is the BEST option. The service was outstanding. The 2 servers were friendly, entertaining, and knowledgeable. Thank you Yvette and Gage! They truly made the experience wonderful. I recommend the blackened gator, seafood gumbo, buffalo and charbroiled oysters, and red beans and rice. All the food was flavorful and phenomenal, do not waste your time at the Gumbo Shop come here for good gumbo. Overall, we will be back if in the area.
Excellent Staff . Friendly and huge portions for the Pear and Gorgonzola salad. Loved having lunch there. Would be nice with some music to go with the old restaurant vibe.would repeat.

The manager Kendell greeted us at the door, he was very welcoming even though it was late night. Casey was our server and very efficient and very friendly. Food was amazing. I love the new renovations.
Nothing special, but it wasn't bad. We got the shrimp scampi, and it was not close to shrimp scampi. But the Romeo and Juliet dish was really good!

This place is the only place that has constantly messed my order up but yet i went back. Triple with cheese and ketchup and they forget the cheese everytime.. then informed me they got new staff then when i call for redemption meal which was what i was told before, they then proceed to tell me they aren't replacing. Idc i pay for my food but customer service is the worst. Too bad its the only one on my side of town. Heres me adding cheese in my own sandwich. Avoid if possible. My family will also leave reviews for they are witnesses. Thank you have a great day.

Are you in a good rut?  Tired of eating the same thing?  Wake up your taste buds with a trip to Bunga Raya. 

There are traditional Chinese and Japanese dishes on the menu but stretch your taste buds and order the things you've never heard of. I don't have a lot of experience with Malaysian cuisine but what I tried here was tasty and I'd go back for more. 

I got the curried noodle and it tasted like a happy marriage between Vietnamese pho and panang curry. The bowl was huge and I could not finish it. My mouth also has a pleasant afterglow from the zip of the curry. 

I can't wait to try new things next time.

I love this place!  I usually get 2 eggs, hash browns and link sausages! I get a regular coffee and a orange juice!   
The biggest deal:
A). Very food is very high quality!
B)  the service is very good!

The Owner is Cezar....he usually comes by to everyone if he is satisfied; He owns in Fortville and Mornings!  He is a good owner and restaurant-or because he cares about the people!

The restaurant is very nice and clean!
Panang curry is AMAZING! Good spice, rich, and delicious. Call ahead and pick up is so easy and the owners are friendly and helpful. We love this place!
